scientific_integrity: Closed-form proof of the full continuum optimum using the reflection principle and Gaussian integration. Package contains runnable source and checks; numerical tests are independent reproductions but not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a predetermined single zero-threshold sign of free standard Brownian motion; arbitrary decoder allowed. No claim for adjustable thresholds, general binary encoders, adaptive times, noisy sensing or other processes. Priority provisional; no independent audit.
title: A sharp 16/21-horizon sign-sensor rule for Brownian running maxima
